protocol.title: Spatial Proximity Sequencing Maps Developmental Dynamics in the Germinal Center
protocol.institution: Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering / Institute for Genomics and Systems Biology, University of Chicago
protocol.platform: 10x Visium Spatial Gene Expression (slide-based spatial transcriptomics)
protocol.sample_encoded: Sample A1 (representative replicate; B1 and D1 use identical workflow)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous in situ spatial profiling of mRNAs, surface protein abundance (via PLA UMI counts), and protein complexes (via proximity ligation assay) in intact tonsil tissue sections; identification of germinal center spatial architecture and VLA-4-VCAM1 mediated B cell-FDC interactions

probe_design.probe_A: Distinct DNA barcode oligomer; azide-DBCO conjugated to antibody
probe_design.probe_B: Distinct DNA barcode oligomer + 6x 3-prime UTP residues; azide-DBCO conjugated to antibody
probe_design.utp_modification_purpose: USER enzyme cleaves UTP tail post-ligation to expose poly(A) for Visium capture

TonsilTissueSection.description: Fresh-frozen human palatine tonsil, 10-um cryosection mounted on 10x Visium slide
TonsilTissueSection.irb: IRB# 22-1966, University of Chicago Medicine, de-identified

PFA_1pct.purpose: Tissue fixation; preserves morphology and protein epitopes

BSA_BlockingBuffer.purpose: Non-specific binding block before AOC incubation

AOC_CocktailPairs.description: 32-plex antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate cocktail (Probe A + Probe B per target)
AOC_CocktailPairs.preparation: DBCO-PEG4-NHS ester conjugation; 9:1 antibody:DBCO; azide-oligo at 1:3 molar ratio; overnight 4C; purified with 50K MWCO

ProbeBindingBuffer.description: Probe Binding Buffer (10x Visium cassette compatible); contains AOCs at 2.5 nM each

LigationBuffer.description: Ligation Buffer containing T4 DNA ligase (NEB M0202L), 10 mM ATP, RNase inhibitor (NEB M0314L)

WashBuffer1.description: Wash Buffer 1 (stringency wash; removes unbound AOCs and ligation byproducts)

USER_EnzymeBuffer.description: USER Enzyme (NEB M5505L) in compatible buffer; cleaves dU residues in UTP tail of Probe B post-ligation

SSC_1x_DecrosslinkBuffer.description: 1x SSC; used as decrosslinking buffer to reverse PFA crosslinks

PermeabilizationBuffer.description: 10x Visium Permeabilization Buffer; applied dropwise to release mRNA and poly(A)-tailed PLA products from tissue

ReverseTranscriptaseReagents.description: 10x Visium RT reagent mix including U-Fwd primer (modification for PLA amplification)
ReverseTranscriptaseReagents.notes: U-Fwd primer added to enhance PLA product capture; standard Visium Step 1.2 modified

SPRIselect_06x.description: 0.6x SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter B23317); bead fraction retains mRNA cDNA (>600 bp), supernatant contains PLA products

SPRIselect_12x.description: 1.2x SPRIselect beads; post-PLA-PCR amplicon cleanup; elute in 25 uL Buffer EB

SPRIselect_21x.description: 2.1x SPRIselect beads; PLA supernatant cleanup (70 uL beads + 75 uL supernatant)

KAPA_HiFi_Mix.description: KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2x (KAPA Biosystems KK2601); PLA library indexing PCR master mix

BufferEB.description: Buffer EB (Qiagen 19086); PLA library elution buffer after 1.2x SPRI cleanup

IndexingPrimers.description: Custom PLA library indexing and sequencing primers (IDT; see Table S4)

PhiX_Spike.description: PhiX Control v3 (Illumina); spike-in for sequencing quality control

PLA_library.custom_primers: Custom read 2 primer + custom i7 primer spiked into reagent cartridge (Table S4)

protein_complex_identification.method: Fisher's Exact Test (one-sided, 2x2 contingency table per PLA pair per spot)
protein_complex_identification.output: Binary significant/non-significant per PLA pair per spot

spatial_prevalence.definition: Proportion of tissue spots where a given PLA pair passes Fisher's Exact Test

interaction_strength.formula: F_ij = (F_i + F_j) / 2; where F_i = (O_ij + O_ji) / (sum_l(O_il) + sum_k(O_ki))
interaction_strength.interpretation: Normalized, abundance-aware measure of ligation events shared between two proteins

trajectory_analysis.key_finding: Protein-interaction trajectory: Non-GC follicles -> Dark zone -> Light zone (distinct from RNA trajectory)

steps.name: Tissue section mounting and pre-warming
steps.notes: 10-um section on Visium slide placed on thermocycler adapter at 37C for 1 min before fixation

steps.name: Tissue fixation with 1% PFA
steps.notes: 10 min at room temperature; preserves tissue morphology and protein epitopes

steps.name: Post-fixation wash with 3x SSC (x3)
steps.notes: Three sequential washes to remove residual PFA before blocking

steps.name: Blocking with 1% BSA
steps.notes: Cassette mounted; blocking reduces non-specific AOC binding

steps.name: AOC cocktail incubation (32-plex)
steps.notes: 90 min at 4C; Probe A and Probe B pairs bind target proteins in situ; proximity enables ligation in S7

steps.name: Proximity ligation assay
steps.notes: T4 ligase joins Probe A and Probe B via connector oligomer when both are bound within 50-70 nm; PLA product encodes protein identity

steps.name: Post-ligation wash with Wash Buffer 1 (x4)
steps.notes: Removes unligated probes and ligation byproducts

steps.name: USER enzyme digestion
steps.notes: Cleaves 6x UTP residues at 3-prime end of ligated Probe B; exposes poly(A) tail enabling co-capture of PLA products with mRNA on Visium spatial barcodes

steps.name: Post-USER wash with Wash Buffer 1 (x3) + 3x SSC dip
steps.notes: Removes USER enzyme; 3x SSC dip x20 prepares slide surface for imaging

steps.name: Brightfield imaging
steps.notes: Slide removed from cassette; brightfield and H&E morphology recorded for tissue cluster annotation; slide remounted after imaging

steps.name: Decrosslinking
steps.notes: 1x SSC at 70C for 15 min reverses PFA crosslinks; restores mRNA and PLA product mobility for capture

steps.name: Room temperature equilibration
steps.notes: 10 min equilibration after decrosslinking before next wash

steps.name: Tissue permeabilization
steps.notes: Applied dropwise; releases mRNA poly(A) tails and USER-digested PLA products for capture by poly(dT) spatial barcodes on Visium slide surface

steps.name: Post-permeabilization wash with 0.1x SSC (x2)
steps.notes: Gentle wash; captured mRNAs and PLA products remain bound to spatial barcodes

steps.name: Reverse transcription (cDNA synthesis)
steps.modification: U-Fwd primer added to RT mix to enhance PLA product amplification in subsequent PCR
steps.notes: Standard 10x Visium Step 1.2; captures both mRNA-derived cDNA and PLA products on spatial barcodes

steps.name: cDNA amplification and SPRI separation
steps.notes: U-Fwd primer also added during second-strand synthesis; SPRI separation is the key library split step

steps.name: PLA library cleanup, indexing PCR, and quantification
steps.operation: 2.1x SPRI cleanup + indexing PCR + 1.2x SPRI cleanup + elution
steps.notes: Custom sequencing primers spiked into cartridge; 40% PhiX required due to low sequence complexity of PLA barcodes

steps.name: PLA library QC gate

pass.action: dispose pla_Library; dispose plaQCPassFlag (dummy for CFG jump)

steps.compiler_note: PATCH 1 applied: plaQCPassFlag dummy dispense+dispose forces compiler to emit explicit jump from BB2 to BB4

steps.name: cDNA library preparation and QC gate
VLA-4-VCAM1 protein complex detection gate (downstream analysis)
steps.biological_basis: ITGA4-VCAM1 and CD29-VCAM1 PLA pairs pass Fisher's Exact Test and show highest enrichment in Light zone across all 3 replicates; direct capture of in trans B cell-FDC interaction
steps.compiler_note: PATCH 2 applied: pla_SequencingLib uses cDNA_FinalLib (in-scope) instead of pla_Library to avoid undefined SSA slot pla_Library2[0]

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Steps S1-S19: full wet-lab workflow from tissue mounting to PLA library QC detect

basic_blocks.label: plaQCJoin
basic_blocks.content: dispose(plaQCSignal); cDNA library prep + rnaQCSignal detect

bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_unit_notes: All durations in s or m only (BioScript does not support h token)
bioscript_compiler_notes.temperature_notes: All temperatures as integer Celsius; RT modelled as 25c
bioscript_compiler_notes.abstraction_notes: mix abstracts cassette-based incubation/wash events; heat abstracts thermocycler/heat-block steps; dispense abstracts pipetting into Visium cassette well
